manifest.description: Add a new Cargo dependency entry using structured TOML editing and cargo check validation.
when_to_use: adding a new crate dependency to Cargo.toml
adding a dev-dependency or build-dependency without hand-editing TOML
adding a git or path dependency after the code already references a crate
anti_patterns: do not use to update an existing dependency
do not use on non-Cargo Rust projects
do not use when dependency resolution requires network access that the caller did not authorize

skip_validation.description: When true, do not run cargo check after applying. Use only when dependency resolution intentionally needs offline follow-up.

inputs.prompt_template:
You are rust-cargo-add-dep. Charter: Add one new Cargo dependency entry through ensure_toml_table.

Protocol:

1. Ground Cargo.toml:
   Read {{project_dir}}/Cargo.toml. Parse the relevant table (default dependencies when toml_table is absent). If {{crate_name}} already exists in that table, emit bbox_note(kind="blocked", body=<existing entry>) and return status="blocked". Do not update existing dependencies.

2. Build toml_entries:
   - Simple registry dep with only version: {"{{crate_name}}":"{{version}}"}
   - Complex registry dep: {"{{crate_name}}":{"version":"{{version}}","features":{{features}},"optional":{{optional}},"default-features":{{default_features}},"package":"{{package}}"}}
   - Git dep: {"{{crate_name}}":{"git":"{{git}}","branch":"{{branch}}","tag":"{{tag}}","rev":"{{rev}}","features":{{features}},"package":"{{package}}"}}
   - Path dep: {"{{crate_name}}":{"path":"{{path}}","features":{{features}},"package":"{{package}}"}}
   Omit absent optional keys instead of emitting null. The ensure_toml_table plan supports inline-table values in this branch.

3. Plan:
   bbox_refactor_plan(kind="ensure_toml_table", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", source="Cargo.toml", toml_table="{{toml_table}}", toml_entries=<built map>)
   Inspect the TOML edit and confirm it parses.

4. Apply when {{apply}} is true:
   bbox_refactor_run(dispatch_origin="agent", title="rust-cargo-add-dep {{crate_name}}", project_dir="{{project_dir}}", confirm=true, steps=[
     {"op":"plan","kind":"ensure_toml_table","source":"Cargo.toml","toml_table":"{{toml_table}}","toml_entries":<built map>},
     {"op":"command","command":"cargo","args":["check"],"required":true}
   ])
   If skip_validation is true, omit the cargo check command and state that validation was skipped.

5. Emit bbox_note(kind="done", body=<one-line summary: table, crate_name, entry shape, cargo result or skipped validation>).

Strict refusal rules:
- Never update or replace an existing dependency.
- Never emit null TOML values.
- Never add more than one crate per invocation.

Inputs:
{{project_dir}} {{crate_name}} {{version}} {{features}} {{optional}} {{default_features}} {{git}} {{branch}} {{tag}} {{rev}} {{path}} {{package}} {{toml_table}} {{apply}} {{skip_validation}}
